context:
Goal: on the open Duo, the left page (Tally, Orphaned, Card in Hand) ends at its last row, with no blank strip, and nothing covers that row.
Problem (rule): the zero-margin fix for debt duo-left-page-dead-margin failed review. The 76 pt margin also keeps the last row clear of the keys and of the error bar in Tally and Orphaned. A full fix edits Tally and Orphaned view files, which the Duo lane may not touch without a ruling.
Based on (read): review round 1, reviewer haiku, 2026-11-07 20:00 CST (TallyView.swift:36, OrphanedView.swift:32; keys at about 405 pt per measurements/duo-fold-and-keyboard.md).
Based on (read): the coordinator's lane plan gives TallyView to the Restyle lane.
Departs from: main, where every left page ends with a fixed 76 pt bar margin — the margin shrinks to 0, the error bar becomes a bottom inset, and room is made only while the keys are up.
Unvetted: the past-ruling check timed out (model subprocess), so this was not checked against past rulings.
Closed 2026-11-07 20:05 CST: the coordinator picked option b at 20:04 CST under its file-ownership rule (restyle owns TallyView and OrphanedView, and step 8 edits them). It was not the owner's answer. The fix is withdrawn, and the debt names the inset fix and stays open until step 8.
home: debt duo-left-page-dead-margin (branch duo-left-margin-rec daf6318, landing at merge)

options.gain: The blank strip goes, and nothing covers the last row.
options.how: TallyView and OrphanedView show the error bar as a bottom inset, and the left page makes room only while the keys are up.
options.label: Move the error bar into a bottom inset, and let the margin follow the keys
options.lose: The Duo lane edits the Tally and Orphaned view files.

options.gain: No edit outside the Duo files.
options.how: The 76 pt margin stays, and the debt says it guards the keys and the error bar.
options.label: Withdraw the fix, and rewrite the debt
options.lose: 76 pt of blank scroll stays at the end of each left page while the keys are down.

ref: debt duo-left-page-dead-margin (blank strip under the Duo left page); review round 1, 2026-11-07 20:00 CST; TallyView.swift:36, OrphanedView.swift:32; measurements/duo-fold-and-keyboard.md
title: The open Duo's left pages end in a 76 pt blank strip. Remove it by editing Tally and Orphaned, or keep it?
why: It is the only option that removes the blank strip and still keeps the last row clear.
